name: First five

sprites.name: Delta Charizard
sprites.note: Front: nothing is left between the bones now. The dark lines between the ribs are gone, so every gap is see-through, as the middle is. To keep each rib outlined, the ribs are redrawn in the original's shape: dipping toward the middle, lighter in front and darker at the sides so the chest reads as round. Back: the spine stands nearly upright now and the ribs are even on both sides of it, so the back no longer bends. The head sits just forward of the top of the spine on a short neck.

note: Eighteenth look. Delta Charizard: see-through between every bone on the front, and an upright, balanced back.
